validation_notes: Processed 11 CSV people for IRAO. Checked 3 local documents in MOEXBMI_Отчеты_2024/IRAO before web search: annual report, corporate-governance-code compliance report and consolidated financial statements. Completed 11 person-rounds (one round per CSV person). Education was found for all 11 people. No patents or h-index values were added because no reliable same-person patent/citation profiles were confirmed. Weaker web confirmations used: Rosseti direct profile for Murov timed out and was treated as search-index/auxiliary confirmation; RAEX/Neftegaz/industry profiles were used only as auxiliary confirmations where the local annual report was primary. Main conflict: CSV lists Sergey Dregval as CEO and Board member, but the 2024 annual report validates him as General Director / Management Board Chair and does not list him as Board member on 31.12.2024; it also states the Board worked with 10 of 11 members after Boris Kovalchuk left on 15.03.2024. Namesakes excluded: unrelated Anatoly Gavrilenko profiles with different birth/career anchors; unrelated Denis Fedorov results without Gazprom/Gazprom Energoholding/Inter RAO anchors. Search considered complete because local official biographies gave education, degrees and recent professional experience, follow-up web searches confirmed identity through current/prior employers and no two successive education/career/science/name-disambiguation passes produced higher-quality new facts or unresolved employer leads. | ROUND 2 (gap-fill + GICS + qualification_degree + institution normalization, completed 2026-07-19, per REFINEMENT.md): (1) Gap-fill: targeted re-research was run per person for every field flagged null/vague in round 1, using local documents first (re-extracted the annual report's Board/Management-body biography pages 208-221 and 231 directly via PyMuPDF to double-check every 'qualification: null' / 'program_or_specialty: null' field against the primary source), then web sources. This session's WebSearch tool quota was already exhausted (200/200) before this ticker was reached; all web research this round was done via the WebFetch tool against html.duckduckgo.com/html search result pages and direct URLs (a documented, already-established workaround used elsewhere in this project today, e.g. GMKN round 2).  Closed gaps: Opadchy's MEPhI program_or_specialty (6 corroborating sources); Sechin's LGU program_or_specialty and 1998 Candidate-of-Economic-Sciences degree institution/year/topic (Wikipedia + dissercat.com, 2 sources); Milovidov's MSU qualification wording and Doctor-of-Economic-Sciences degree institution/year/topic (dissercat.com, MGIMO 2019); Murov's Doctor-of-Economic-Sciences degree year/topic (dissercat.com, 2008); Fedorov's MGTU qualification wording and Candidate-of-Economic-Sciences degree year/topic (Kommersant + dissercat.com, 2003). Not closed (documented, not guessed): Bugrov's, Bystrov's, Lokshin's, Murov's and Shugaev's remaining null qualification words (no directly-quoted person-specific source found); Bugrov's and Shugaev's degree institution/year (Shugaev's only same-name dissercat hit, 'Шугаев Дмитрий Валентинович', was correctly excluded as a namesake -- different patronymic and field of law vs. economics); Fedorov's exact degree institution beyond 'Moscow'; the official Rosseti biography page for Murov (blocked again this round, both by direct ECONNREFUSED and by an archive.org fetch restriction); Milovidov's numeric h-index (a Scopus Author ID, 56694866300, was found via IMEMO's own official page, but Scopus itself returned HTTP 403 and no number could be verified, so h_index stays null and the ID is recorded only as a lead). No previously-confirmed fact was re-verified from scratch or deleted; the CEO (Dregval) and Gavrilenko had no null education fields to begin with, so only structural fields (GICS, qualification_degree, institution normalization) were added for them.  (2) GICS: company-level sector=Utilities/industry_group=Utilities/industry=Electric Utilities added verbatim from gics_taxonomy.json, justified by the annual report's own description (pp.4-10: thermal and hydro power generation, energy sales companies in 67 regions, all Russian electricity import/export). All 42 professional_experience entries across all 11 people received sector/industry_group/industry, classified by each organization's own primary business, not a subsidiary's: Inter RAO group entities (Inter RAO itself, MRSK Urala, FGC UES/Russian Grids/Rosseti, SO EES) -> Electric Utilities; Gazprom Energoholding / Tsentrenergoholding (generation-only holdings without a retail distribution franchise, by analogy to this project's own ELFV file) -> Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers; Gazprom, Rosneft -> Oil, Gas & Consumable Fuels; Nornickel -> Metals & Mining; Interros, Leader, ATS and NP Market Council (asset management / market-infrastructure operators) -> Financial Services (New Name)/Capital Markets, the first two reused directly from this project's own already-processed GMKN file for the identical organizations; Rosatom -> Industrial Conglomerates and Atomstroyexport (ASE) -> Construction & Engineering, by analogy to this project's AFLT-file treatment of Rostec; MGIMO -> Consumer Services/Diversified Consumer Services, by analogy to this project's AFLT-file treatment of universities. Set to null/null/null with a stated reason (regional/federal government bodies: Saint Petersburg administration, FSVTS; industry/professional associations: RSPP, RNC CIGRE, Digital Energy Association; state-funded research institutes without a commercial GICS bucket: RISS, IMEMO) -- reasons are recorded both inline in the relevant professional_experience description and summarized here.  (3) qualification_degree added to all 19 education[] and all 6 degrees[] entries across all 11 people. Pre-Bologna (pre-~2003-2011) Soviet/Russian 5-year programmes -> Specialist degree, with the graduation year and the classical specialist-track qualification word (e.g. inzhener, inzhener-fizik, yurist, ekonomist-matematik, ekonomist-menedzher) cited as the reasoning in each entry's own description field. Russian 'kandidat nauk' degrees -> Doctoral degree (nearest available enum value; this project's own established convention, consistent with e.g. this project's GAZP file). The 2001 Academy-of-National-Economy 'Prezident' programme (Lokshin) -> Executive education, a high-confidence classification since this is Russia's well-documented federal Presidential Programme for senior-manager training, not an academic degree. Explicit retraining/short programmes (Murov's 1998 professional retraining, Opadchy's 1998 requalification programme and, by analogy of phrasing and sequence, his 1999 Financial Academy programme) -> Professional certification. All reasoning is stated per-entry in the corresponding description field, per the project rule that any contextual inference must be justified.  (4) Institution normalization: all 16 distinct institution strings used across the 11 people were checked against university_names.json and every one was already present as a listed variant (no institution required manual best-guess naming); normalized in place: 'GOU VPO Tyumen State Oil and Gas University' -> 'Tyumen Industrial University' (Тюменский индустриальный университет); 'Leningrad State University' -> 'Saint Petersburg State University' (Санкт-Петербургский государственный университет); 'Leningrad Polytechnic Institute named after M. I. Kalinin' -> 'Peter the Great St. Petersburg Polytechnic University' (Санкт-Петербургский политехнический университет Петра Великого); 'MGTU named after N. E. Bauman' -> canonical Bauman Moscow State Technical University name (Московский государственный технический университет имени Н.Э. Баумана); both MGIMO variants -> canonical 'Московский государственный институт международных отношений (университет) Министерства иностранных дел Российской Федерации'; 'MSU named after M. V. Lomonosov' (old spacing) -> canonical spelling 'Московский государственный университет имени М.В. Ломоносова'; 'Moscow Civil Engineering Institute named after V. V. Kuybyshev' -> 'Национальный исследовательский Московский государственный строительный университет'; 'Moscow Engineering Physics Institute (technical university)' -> 'Национальный исследовательский ядерный университет «МИФИ»'; 'Moscow Power Engineering Institute (Technical University)' -> 'Национальный исследовательский университет «МЭИ»'; 'Academy of National Economy under the Government of the Russian Federation' -> 'Российская академия народного хозяйства и государственной службы при Президенте Российской Федерации'; 'Finance Academy under the Government of the Russian Federation' -> 'Финансовый университет при Правительстве Российской Федерации'; 'State University of Civil Aviation' -> 'Санкт-Петербургский государственный университет гражданской авиации'.  Institutions newly added this round to degrees[] entries (Sechin's Saint Petersburg Mining University -- Санкт-Петербургский горный университет императрицы Екатерины II -- and Milovidov's MGIMO) were likewise already-listed canonical entries or variants; new_institutions_found for IRAO is an empty list -- no institution encountered required a new best-guess canonical name to be logged. (5) Self-check performed programmatically against gics_taxonomy.json and university_names.json: every qualification_degree value is one of the 10 allowed strings or null (19/19 education entries and 6/6 degrees entries populated); every non-null sector/industry_group/industry triple (company-level and all 42 professional_experience entries) is an exact row from gics_taxonomy.json; every non-null institution string (education[] and degrees[]) matches a listed variant in university_names.json. No prior field was deleted -- all changes are additions, or, for institution normalization (explicitly required by this task's step 4), like-for-like renaming to the canonical spelling of the same institution, with the original source wording preserved in each entry's own description text.
